features.name: Circle Spells
features.desc: You choose a land type (arid, polar, temperate, or tropical) — its associated spells are always prepared and don't count against your limit.

features.name: Land's Aid
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you expend a use of Wild Shape: a creature within 60 feet regains Hit Points or takes 2d6 Necrotic damage (increases with level).

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.desc: During a Short Rest, you recover expended spell slots with a combined level of up to half your Druid level.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.desc: Immunity to poison and disease; Resistance to one elemental damage type of your choice.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you create an area that enemies can't enter without succeeding on a Wisdom saving throw.
